text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross and I have already
finished the
day's entire training
schedule, but then...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, am I okay to get a few more laps
in?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I just got off the phone with my family
back
home. They said I should keep
doin' my best!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hearin' that was a real motivation
booster! So
now I wanna run like it's
goin' outta style!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, just what I wanted to hear! Okay,
I'm off to
run!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best to live up to th...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna train up 'n show the squirts
back home
how I look in first place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross pulls out all the stops as
she keeps
training hard.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay... You might be right. If I keep
trainin'
now, I won't have energy to give
it my best
tomorrow...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So I'll just take it easy 'n rest up. And
then I'll
channel all that energy into our
next session!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her plan set, Tamamo Cross heads
back to
the dorm.
